items.q: Do I really own the store?
items.a: Yes. The design, code, and your customer and product data are fully yours.

items.q: Is there a monthly fee or commission on sales?
items.a: No. You pay once, and we take no share of your sales.
Domain and hosting coverage details and the yearly renewal price are to be confirmed with the Bosla team. (to confirm)
One week from receiving all your products and images.

items.q: Do I need a developer to run the store?
items.a: No. You add products and track orders yourself from the control panel.

items.q: Can you move my products from my current store?
items.a: Product migration from an existing store is available in some packages — contact us for details. (to confirm)

items.q: Does the store support tax e-invoicing?
items.a: E-invoicing integration details are to be confirmed with the Bosla team. (to confirm)

items.a: لا. تدفع مرة واحدة، ولا نأخذ أي نسبة من مبيعاتك.
مدة الشمول وسعر التجديد السنوي يُحدد ويُتفق عليه مع فريق بوصلة. (قيد التأكيد)
أسبوع من استلام المنتجات والصور كاملة.
لا، تضيف منتجاتك وتتابع طلباتك بنفسك من لوحة التحكم.

items.q: هل تساعدونني في نقل منتجاتي من متجر حالي؟
